22c.budget: briefs/22c-ways-back-after-update.md: at most four VM dispatches in all (vm_dispatch_cap: the probe and the stage 2 rehearsal together) and 1200 minutes. Checks-only runs are counted in the minutes; their own cap only keeps the ledger finite (it stops a runaway dispatch loop). Raised from 12 to 30 in stage 1b, step 2 (2026-11-14): the branch had used 18 checks runs and 446 of the 1200 minutes; each checks run costs about 35 runner minutes while the full model runs beside it, so after one rehearsal reservation (345) about 11 more fit, and 30 lets the minutes stay the real bound. Standard runners cost nothing for this public repository. Stage 2 (2026-11-14): the rehearsal of every way back is the mode ways-back; the probe used one of the four VM dispatches, so three remain for it. Stage 2, step 2 (integrator's decision, 2026-11-14): the minute cap is raised from 1200 to 2400 and the VM dispatch cap from 4 to 6 (ways-back from 3 to 5: the probe used one of the six). The runners are free for this public repository; the caps exist to stop runaway loops, and a rehearsal that stops on a harness pin needs room to finish: run 43581458429 passed E1 and stopped in E2 on the harness's own tools-folder pin, and the branch stood at 819 of 1200 minutes, where a new head's checks run (about 36) and one rehearsal reservation (345) no longer fit.
